knowledgePointResolution.currentCanonicalKnowledgePointNameZh: 整數數線刻度、讀值與定位
knowledgePointResolution.rationale: Current canonical KP scope 已明列『讀值、定位、補刻度與位置配對』；Rank04 COMPLETE_MISSING_TICK_VALUES 是同一 uniform integer-number-line scale operation 的缺值重建，不應新增 KP。
knowledgePointResolution.staleVisualCandidateNote: visual family 仍帶有早期 candidateKnowledgePointIds=[kp_g3a_u01_range_reasoning]；current knowledge authority 與 mapping candidate 的 number-line scale dependency 優先，Rank04 應解析到既有 canonical number-line KP。

mappingReadback.operationContract: reconstruct missing tick labels from visible anchors on a uniform integer scale

rank04RequiredExtension: question representation must intentionally omit one or more legal tick labels while preserving enough visible anchors to infer one unique step
answer representation must restore every missing tick value without changing the scale geometry
validator must derive each missing value by tickValue(index) = startValue + index * step
visible labels supplied in the question must be preserved exactly in the answer representation
completed labels must remain strictly increasing left-to-right

inputRoles.startValue: 數線起點整數值或可由 visible anchors 推得的基準值
inputRoles.visibleAnchors: 題目保留的已知刻度值
inputRoles.missingTickIndices: 題目刻意隱藏標籤的合法刻度索引

legalCompletionConditions: all visible anchor labels are consistent with one uniform positive integer step
the visible anchors determine a unique scale
every missingTickIndex is a legal tick index
every reconstructed missing value is an integer within 0..10000
question and answer use identical tick geometry
formalOperationPreflight.answerSemantics: learner supplies the ordered missing integer tick values; answer key restores those values at their exact tick positions

allowed: resolve Rank04 mapping candidate to the already canonical number-line KP
record Rank02/Rank03 renderer/runtime reuse and exact Rank04 missing-label extension needs
lock the next FormalMapping/PatternSpec contract scope
